newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 19.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- North Korea defector Hwang Jang-yop arrived in the Philippines and was taken to the mountain resort of Baguio from Clark airport.
- The Hanbo Special Committee in the National Assembly will open an investigation on March 21 for 45 days.
- The government said it will pass legilation making money laundering illegal to prevent the accumulation of sluch funds.
- Korea Labour Institute said unemployment increased by 170,000 people from October 1996 to January 1997.
- South Korea's labour minister Jin Nyum offered his resignation on Tuesday.
